activities.title: Choose a product-value metric and supporting measures
activities.source_ref: https://review.firstround.com/how-to-measure-product-market-fit/ — How to find PMF; How to measure PMF
activities.purpose: Keep product learning tied to meaningful usage.
steps: Start with a customer/problem thesis and test a focused product.
Use product-experience feedback to investigate fit.
Select a primary metric relevant to value and track useful supporting measures.
Distinguish impressive totals from operational signals.
activities.independence: Can be drafted early; actual PMF measurement requires experienced users.
activities.ai_role: Ask focused questions, organize answers and flag unsupported claims.
activities.human_role: Supply context, correct assumptions and choose the result.
activities.skill_idea: Proposed: inspect existing work, ask only for missing context, draft this output, then review it with the user.
cautions: The article’s metric menu is not a prescription to track every metric or treat market size as a usage outcome.
